input.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
input.rationale: Compliant with the preferred position ("No non-solicit on Customer"): the Base Terms impose no non-solicitation, no-hire or inducement restriction on Bluefly. § 14.8 Personnel deals only with each party's supervision of its own personnel, IBM's right to assign its personnel and IBM's right to subcontract; § 14.16 Freedom of Action goes the other way, confirming "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others." I also read the Preamble and definitions in full (pp0000-p0036) and ran full-text searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "induce", "recruit" and "personnel"; the only "employ" hits are the Content Administrator definition and the indemnity clauses. No restrictive covenant exists. Accordingly no redline and no counterparty comment are proposed - inserting a 12-month cap or a general-solicitation carve-out would require first drafting in a restriction against ourselves, which is worse than the status quo. The failed sub-checks on duration and general-solicitation carve-out are therefore non-probative. Residual scope note: the Agreement also incorporates Order Forms, Attachment A (Facilities Services) and the Service Option Attachments, which are not part of the reviewed text; if any of those contains a hiring restriction we would negotiate to the fallback (mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, and no no-hire).
